November Got Busy Fast

November has already been a busy month at Walt Disney World. There are new 2027 discounts to look at, extended Thanksgiving-week park hours, another family-friendly addition coming to Hollywood Studios, holiday party schedules that can change your park day, and a few resort updates worth knowing before you book.

None of these are the kind of stories that need a giant breaking-news headline on their own. But together, they can absolutely affect how you plan a trip.

So instead of trying to catch up on every little announcement from the last couple of weeks, I pulled together the updates I think are actually worth knowing right now.

2027 Disney Savings Are Starting to Stack Up

If you’re already looking ahead to a 2027 Disney World trip, there are a couple of new savings offers worth knowing about.

Florida residents can now save up to 30% on rooms at select Disney Resort hotels for eligible stays from January 3 through April 29, 2027.

The exact savings will vary by resort, room type, and travel dates, but if you’re a Florida resident planning a winter or spring trip, it’s definitely worth checking before you book.

Disney also released its 2027 military offers this week, including the traditional 4-, 5-, and 6-day Military Salute tickets, a year-long repeat-visit option, and resort savings of up to 30%.

There are quite a few details that go along with those offers, especially when it comes to eligibility, ticket choices, blockout dates, and pricing.

I already put together a full guide with everything in one place, so if your family is considering the 2027 military offers, you can find all of those details there.

Hollywood Studios Is Getting Another Place for Kids to Play

Artist concept courtesy of Disney.

This one may not sound like a huge announcement at first, but I actually think it could be a really nice addition for families with younger kids.

Disney is adding a new outdoor play area near Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular! called Epic Jr. Stunt Spectacular!

And honestly, Hollywood Studios could use more places like this.

It’s such a fun park, but it can also feel very go-go-go — ride, show, line, snack, repeat. If you have a little one who just needs to move around without standing in another queue, a playground can completely change the mood of the day.

The new area is supposed to have an Indiana Jones-inspired adventure feel, so it sounds like Disney is trying to make it more than just a basic play structure.

There’s no exact opening date yet, only that it’s expected in the coming months.

But I’m keeping an eye on this one because sometimes the smallest additions end up being the ones families are most thankful for in the middle of a long park day.

Thanksgiving Week Just Got Longer at Several Parks

If you’re heading to Disney World over Thanksgiving week, this is one of those updates that can actually change how your day feels.

Disney has extended operating hours at Magic Kingdom, Hollywood Studios, and Animal Kingdom on select dates from November 22 through November 28.

And during one of the busiest travel weeks of the year, even an extra hour or two can be a pretty big deal.

It can mean getting into the park earlier, having a little more breathing room between attractions, or finally having enough time to slow down for dinner instead of feeling like you’re racing the clock all day.

I especially like seeing later hours at Animal Kingdom.

This is the time of year when the sun goes down early enough that families have a much better chance of seeing Pandora glowing after dark and catching the Tree of Life Awakenings without needing a super-late park night.

The Christmas Parties Are Officially Underway

The holiday parties are officially underway now, and even if you’re not buying a party ticket, they can still affect your park plans quite a bit.

Mickey’s Very Merry Christmas Party takes over Magic Kingdom on 25 nights between November 8 and December 22. On those dates, Magic Kingdom closes to regular day guests at 6:00 PM so the separately ticketed party can begin at 7:00 PM.

That’s a lot of evenings without the regular nighttime experience.

So if seeing Magic Kingdom after dark, catching the nighttime entertainment, or simply having a longer park day matters to you, the party calendar is worth noticing before you pick your Magic Kingdom date.

Hollywood Studios has fewer party nights, but Jollywood still changes the schedule on 15 evenings between November 7 and January 5. On those dates, regular guests leave at 7:00 PM before Jollywood Nights begins at 7:30 PM.

The interesting part is that an early-closing day isn’t automatically a bad park day.

At Magic Kingdom especially, some families avoid party dates because they want the longer evening, which can make the daytime feel different from a regular non-party day.

So this is one of those holiday-season planning quirks where the “shorter” day may still be a perfectly good choice — as long as you know what kind of day you’re choosing.

Animal Kingdom’s Christmas Season Has Begun

Animal Kingdom officially joined the holiday season on November 13, and I think this park is especially fun at Christmas because it doesn’t try to copy what the other parks are doing.

You’ve got the Merry Menagerie, Santa’s new Holiday Grove, Mickey and Minnie in their holiday outfits, and the Tree of Life Awakenings after dark — plus all the little decorations and storytelling details tucked around the park.

And honestly, some of my favorite Animal Kingdom holiday moments happen once the sun goes down.

I just put together a full guide to Christmas at Animal Kingdom, including the new-for-2026 experiences, Pandora after dark, and the little details that make this park feel so different during the holidays.

Planning a Wilderness Lodge Stay? Put These Dates on Your Radar

If Wilderness Lodge is on your list for 2027 or early 2028, there are a few refurbishment dates worth knowing before you book.

The main resort guest rooms are scheduled for refurbishment from July through September 2027, and Disney is also planning work at Copper Creek Springs Pool from January through spring 2028.

There’s still exterior work happening around the resort now too, with some projects continuing through late 2026.

None of that automatically makes Wilderness Lodge a bad choice.

But it does mean I’d want to know what part of the resort is being worked on during my stay — especially if I were choosing Wilderness Lodge because I wanted a quieter resort day, a certain view, or time at the pool.

Disney notes that guests may see or hear construction during daytime hours, and some views may be affected while work is underway.
